prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: seamless production background texture for a campaign design system
Primary request: a seamless tileable wheat-paste paper grain, entirely blank and free of text
Style/medium: high-resolution scanned fine-art paper texture, physically plausible
Composition/framing: uniform edge-to-edge surface, no objects, no folds, no deckled edges, no vignette; designed to tile invisibly in every direction
Lighting/mood: diffuse neutral flatbed-scan illumination, calm and tactile
Color palette: warm wheat, pale straw, subtle oat beige
Materials/textures: extremely fine paper fibers, tiny pulp flecks, slight uncoated tooth, understated mottling
Constraints: no typography, logos, marks, borders, shadows, objects, UI chrome, watermark, or directional lighting; seamless repeat texture
